### Validation and limits

Two screened development records—PMIDs **27594086** and **24550881**—were both retrieved (100% relative recall against this small development set). Recall was **not independently validated**; this is not an estimate of sensitivity. Small-sample and simulation blocks were tested but left out: requiring either would reduce retrieval substantially, and only two relevant records were known. Their comparison, sample-size, simulation, and social/behavioural-science eligibility details must therefore be screened.

The search needs **independent PRESS peer review by an information specialist before use**. The internal critique was same-context because no fresh-context reviewer was available. The query, audit, and validation manifest are intact under `./work`.
